verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API that exposes a deployment's public functions at HTTP endpoints and returns their results as values. It also offers client libraries in several languages, and custom HTTP actions are documented in llms.txt. An AI-native user can therefore drive a deployment programmatically through documented interfaces. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), documented API coverage for management operations such as deploys, schema and environment changes (these appear only in the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTTP API.
